Origin and meaning

The name Susan has Hebrew roots and means “lily (from Susanna)”.

About the name Susan

A Hebrew name meaning 'lily', from the biblical Susanna.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Susan as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “lily (from Susanna)”, is part of the appeal.
